name: application-applicant-card
title: Applicant Card
description: Hiring-pipeline applicant card with initials avatar, name, role applied for, a 5-star interviewer rating, a resume link, and a pipeline-stage badge.
useWhen: An applicant tracking system needs a compact card summarizing a candidate within a pipeline stage column.
Interviewer ratings, resume access, and current stage all need to be visible without opening a full profile.
You want a consistent card shape to place inside stage columns (Applied, Interview, Offer) like candidate-pipeline-stage.
avoidWhen: You need full candidate profile detail (work history, notes, scorecards) — link out to a detail view from this card instead of expanding it in place.
There's no rating yet (unreviewed candidates) — omit the star row or show an explicit 'Not yet rated' state rather than all-empty stars.
The context isn't hiring — use contact-card for general people records instead.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a fixed max-w-sm block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: The star rating uses role="img" with an aria-label stating the rating in words ('Rated 4 out of 5 stars'), since the visual stars alone convey nothing to screen readers.
The resume link is a real anchor with visible icon plus text, not an icon-only button.
The stage badge is plain text in a colored pill, not conveyed by color alone.

variants.title: Applicant card
variants.description: Marcus Kim applying for Senior Product Designer, rated 4 of 5 stars, with a resume link and an 'Interview' stage badge.
accessibility: Empty stars use a distinct light gray, not simply an opacity reduction, keeping filled vs. unfilled unambiguous.

variants.title: Applicant card (Dark)
variants.description: Applicant card adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Star, badge, and link colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
